name: Clearfy Safe
author: techcriterion

sections.description:
Clearfy Safe gives you the most useful WordPress optimizations in one place — carefully chosen to never conflict with your theme or other plugins.

Developed and maintained by TechCriterion — a site dedicated to honest WordPress reviews, tools and guides.

⚡ Recommended (enabled by default)

Transliteration
* Converts Cyrillic post/page slugs to Latin automatically on save
* Optional 301 redirect from old Cyrillic URLs to new Latin URLs — perfect for existing sites

Clean
* Removes generator, wlwmanifest, RSD meta tags
* Disables WordPress emoji scripts (saves one HTTP request per page)
* Disables oEmbed discovery links

Performance
* Reduces Heartbeat API frequency from 15s to 60s
* Minifies HTML output — safe, does not touch JS or CSS
* Adds lazy loading to all images automatically

Security
* Hides WordPress version from HTML, scripts and styles
* Disables /author/username/ pages that expose admin logins
* Shows a generic message on failed login (prevents username enumeration)

🔧 Additional (disabled by default)

Editor & Widgets
* Disable Gutenberg and use Classic Editor — works with Elementor, Divi, WPBakery
* Remove unused default WordPress widgets from the widget panel

Updates
* Control which components auto-update: core, plugins, themes

Comments
* Disable comments site-wide for all post types

Why Clearfy Safe?

  • Every option is independent — enable only what you need
  • No JS/CSS minification that breaks themes
  • No REST API blocking that breaks WooCommerce
  • Tested with popular themes: Astra, GeneratePress, Divi, OceanWP
  • Tested with popular plugins: WooCommerce, Elementor, WPML, Yoast SEO
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Upload clearfy-safe.zip
  3. Click Activate
  4. Go to Settings → Clearfy Safe
  5. Recommended options are already enabled — click Save settings
sections.faq:
Will this conflict with my caching plugin?

No. Clearfy Safe does not touch caching. It works alongside WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache and others.

Is it safe to enable transliteration on an existing site?

Yes, if you also enable the 301 redirect option. Old Cyrillic URLs will automatically redirect to the new Latin ones.

Can I use this with Elementor or Divi?

Yes. All options are safe for page builders. The Gutenberg disable option specifically keeps Elementor and Divi working normally.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. None of the options affect WooCommerce functionality.
